correctness.rationale: Gas kinetic balance implies R(g)=g-g²/m and U′=-g, providing exact inverse survival quantiles. The core has normalized radial density m exp(-m y), and the exterior gas carries exactly \(q^{-1}\) mass. Explicit differentiation gives strict physical quantile decrease for every fixed s, including across \(q=1\); the one-sided derivative difference is level-independent. Coexisting profiles differ by a strictly positive integral. The high-rate TV distance equals a nonzero \(q^{-1}\) translated-tail L¹ coefficient exactly, and uniform low-q analytic inversion yields sharp TV \(q/(4m)+O(q^2)\). Script verify_quantile.py passed 3123 deterministic supporting assertions; finite tests are not used as proofs.

value.rationale: The nonmonotone interface width is not a reliable measure of global mass localization. The theorem establishes an ordering of every stationary radial quantile and every increasing radial observable, resolves which coexisting stationary profile is more concentrated, identifies a level-independent quantile kink at condensation, and supplies exact error and asymptotics for the experimentally meaningful exponential-core approximation. These are motivated collective-statistical properties not previously specified by the source density and interface-width claims.
